findings.quote: Aspose.Cells FOSS for .NET provides core workbook and worksheet functionality through the `Aspose.Cells_FOSS.Workbook` class, which exposes collections for worksheets, defined names, and charts, and supports loading, saving, and protection operations.
findings.truth: Workbook exposes only Worksheets, DefinedNames, Settings, Properties, DocumentProperties and LoadDiagnostics; charts live on Worksheet.Charts and workbook protection is reached via Workbook.Properties.Protection, not Workbook methods.

findings.quote: The `Aspose.Cells_FOSS.SaveFormat` class specifies output formats for saving a workbook, including PDF via `PdfSaveOptions` and other save formats through `SaveOptions`.
findings.truth: SaveFormat is an enum (not a class) with only two members, Xlsx and Pdf; there are no other save formats.

findings.description: confirmed false claim: - **Read and write cell values and formulas.** It writes values of multiple types—includin
findings.quote: - **Read and write cell values and formulas.** It writes values of multiple types—including strings, integers, doubles, and booleans—via `Cell.PutValue`, retrieves them as a variant-typed `CellValue`, and sets or reads formulas with `Cell.SetFormula` and `Cell.GetFormula`, throwing `FormulaException` for invalid formulas.
findings.truth: Cell::SetFormula (Aspose.Cells.Foss.Cpp/src/aspose/cells_foss/Cell.cpp:153) only normalizes and stores the text, and FormulaException is never thrown anywhere in src (only defined in FormulaException.cpp:6).

findings.description: confirmed false claim: - Only `.xlsx` (OOXML) is supported for load and save. `LoadFormat` and `SaveFormat` each
findings.quote: - Only `.xlsx` (OOXML) is supported for load and save. `LoadFormat` and `SaveFormat` each declare a single Xlsx member, and saving to any other format throws `UnsupportedFeatureException`. There is no .xls, .xlsb, .ods, or .csv read/write support. Legacy `SpreadsheetML` is not implemented. `Cell`-level comments/notes are not modeled as a distinct object. Some advanced conditional-formatting rule types are recognized on load but not preserved. `AutoFilter` date-group filters using certain patterns are rejected as unsupported during load.
findings.truth: include/aspose/cells_foss/LoadFormat.h:7-13 declares Auto=0 and Xlsx=1, so 'LoadFormat and SaveFormat each declare a single Xlsx member' is wrong (only SaveFormat.h:7-11 has one member).

findings.description: confirmed false claim: Aspose.Cells FOSS for Cpp reads and writes Excel files in the `.xlsx` format. It provides
findings.quote: Aspose.Cells FOSS for Cpp reads and writes Excel files in the `.xlsx` format. It provides classes such as `Workbook`, `Worksheet`, and `Cell` to create, modify, and save spreadsheets programmatically. The product supports styling with `Style`, `Font`, `Color`, `FillPattern`, and `Borders`, and includes features like formula calculation, validation, hyperlinks, and page setup. It is implemented in C++ using C++17 and requires CMake 3.16 or later.
findings.truth: No formula evaluator exists in the source (only CalculationProperties settings and a number-format EvaluateCondition at DisplayTextFormatterSupport.cpp:345); Cell.cpp:153 SetFormula just stores text, so 'formula calculation' is ungrounded.
